author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I converted my colleague sitting in the next cubicle to join the cult of Claude Code, send him the skills I have been curating for the past few months.

I can see his enlightened moments when he copy and paste a work email to Claude Code and AI finish the task used to take a whole afternoon.  

Once you tasted it, there is no going back.  Welcome to the new world.
